## Previously {#fm5-previously .fm-slide }

$$A=P\left(1+\frac{r}{100}\right)^n\qquad I=A-P$$

**Quick check:** for 12% p.a., compounded monthly, what percentage rate and period count would you use over 11 years?

::: notes
Answer: r=1% per month and n=132 months. Remind students that r is entered as 1 in the displayed percentage-rate formula, so the multiplier is 1.01. Distinguish final amount from interest.
:::
